name: rjdemar
caption:
AGE 26 🎮🏀 DeMar DeRozan at 26 was an All-Star for us. RJ Barrett, born in Toronto, is 26 right now.

• DeMar at 26 (2015-16): 23.5 PPG, 4.5 RPG, 4.0 APG, 44.6 FG%, All-Star, East finals
• RJ at 26, first 9 games: 21.6 PPG, 6.1 RPG, 3.9 APG, 47.4 FG%
• DeMar scores more, RJ rebounds more and shoots better

DeMar at 26 or RJ at 26? 👇

beats.head: DEMAR VS RJ
beats.name: DEMAR
beats.vo: DeMar DeRozan at twenty-six was an All-Star for us. RJ Barrett, born right here in Toronto, is twenty-six right now.

beats.head: DEMAR AT 26
beats.name: DEMAR
beats.vo: DeMar at twenty-six: twenty-three point five points a night, an All-Star, and our first trip to the conference finals.

beats.head: RJ AT 26
beats.name: RJ
beats.vo: RJ at twenty-six, through nine games: twenty-one point six points and six rebounds a night.

beats.head: THE EDGE
beats.name: RJ
beats.vo: DeMar scores more. But RJ rebounds more, and shoots better: forty-seven percent to forty-four.

beats.head: WHO'S BETTER?
beats.vo: DeMar at twenty-six, or RJ at twenty-six? Comment below.

facts.claim: DeRozan (born August 7, 1989) was 26 during the 2015-16 season, was named to the 2016 NBA All-Star Game, and that season Toronto reached the Conference Finals
In 2015-16 Lowry led Toronto to the Eastern Conference finals for the first time
Barrett (born June 14, 2000 in Toronto, Ontario) is 26 and plays for the Toronto Raptors
